instruction: I am an NLP researcher preparing a literature review. Look up the ACL 2020 Outstanding Paper award winner and add it to row 2 of the table best_awards_acl.xlsx on the desktop. Include the paper's title, year (2020), complete author list (comma-separated), and official ACL Anthology PDF link.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Variation 0: Task asks to add ACL 2020 Outstanding Paper award to row 2. Evaluator checks: (1) Title field A is not empty (0.25), (2) Year field B equals 2020 (0.25), (3) Author list field C is not empty (0.25), (4) PDF link field D contains 'aclanthology.org' (0.25). Partial credit enabled for multi-step verification.

scoring_breakdown.1.00: PDF link is from aclanthology.org (column D)

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: All 4 instruction requirements are verified (title, year, authors, PDF link)
Correct row targeting: Getter extracts data from row 2 as specified in instruction
Appropriate validation levels: Uses 'not_empty' for variable content (title, authors), exact match for year (2020), and 'contains' check for PDF link domain
Correct parameter handling: Metric function correctly accesses expected parameter when type='rule' (directly accesses required_fields and partial_credit, not trying to access expected['rules'])
Proper state management: Postconfig activates LibreOffice window and saves file (Ctrl+S) to ensure data persistence before verification
Sensible partial credit: 0.25 per field for 4-step task allows granular progress tracking
Robust edge case handling: Getter handles missing files (returns empty dict), metric handles missing/None values appropriately
